ja432:1.1: Bahussutaṃ cittakathiṃ Gaṅgā vahati Pāṭalaṃ vuyhamānaka bhaddan te, ekaṃ me gāhi gāthakan ti gātham āha.
ja432:2.1: Yena siñcanti dukkhitaṃ yena siñcanti āturaṃ tassa majjhe marissāmi, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayan ti
ja432:3.1: Yattha bījāni rūhanti sattā yattha patiṭṭhitā sā me sīsaṃ nipīḷeti, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayan ti
ja432:4.1: Yena bhattāni paccanti sītaṃ yena vihaññati so maṃ ḍahati gattāni, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayan ti
ja432:5.1: Yena bhuttena yāpenti puthubrāhmaṇakhattiyā so maṃ bhutto vyāpādi, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayan ti
ja432:6.1: Gimhānaṃ pacchime māse vātam icchanti paṇḍitā, so me bhañjati gattāni, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayan ti
ja432:7.1: Yaṃ nissitā jagatiruhaṃ [vihaṅgamā] so 'yaṃ aggiṃ pamuñcati, disā bhajatha vakkaṅgā, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayan ti (= J. I p..)
ja432:8.1: Yam ānayiṃ somanassaṃ māliniṃ candanussadaṃ sā maṃ gharā nicchubhati, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayan ti
ja432:9.1: Yena jātena nandissaṃ yassa ca bhavam icchisaṃ so maṃ gharā nicchubhati, jātaṃ saraṇato {bhayan} ti
ja432:10.1: Suṇantu me jānapadā negamā ca samāgatā: yat' odakaṃ tad ādittaṃ, yato khemaṃ tato bhayaṃ,
ja432:11.1: Rājā vilumpate raṭṭhaṃ brāhmaṇo ca purohito, attaguttā viharatha, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayan ti
